subject: ShellPkg/UefiShellDriver1: Return if ShellCommandLineParse() failed
reasons: Converts 'if (EFI_ERROR(Status)) { handle error; } else { main body; }' to early-return style after ShellCommandLineParse() failure across 11 files

Although the pattern is repeated across files, it is a one-time cleanup of a single subsystem and the transformation requires verifying that no Package free is needed on the error path (due to ShellCommandLineParse internals)
The semantic reasoning required (understanding that Package is already freed internally on parse error) makes this unsuitable for a purely mechanical Coccinelle rule
